description: This file defines an enum named ConnectivityStatus representing various states of a connectivity resource (OPEN, CLOSED, FAILED, UNKNOWN). It provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, value lookup by name, and implements CharSequence for string-like behavior.

classes.name: ConnectivityStatus
classes.description: Enum representing connectivity resource statuses with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Returns a ConnectivityStatus for a given name if it exists.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ConnectivityStatus instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the string name associated with the ConnectivityStatus.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the ConnectivityStatus to its JSON representation.
